Earn as much as you want! $50-$60+ per hour (+) Earn OT if you want (+) Job well done bonus (+) Paid birthday off (+) more fun and laughs!

Do you want a job where you earn top dollar and love coming to work?

Do you want a great place to work where you have plenty of scope to learn, have fun and work on interesting projects? 

Are you a qualified Fridgie or Electrician looking for a challenging role and a fresh start with a growing Airconditioning Company?

Then this role could be perfect for you…if you’ve got what it takes!

We are on the hunt for an A+ Installer. 

We’re Adelaide's #1 Air Conditioning Service and Repair Company and our business is booming. We’ve got so many projects on the go that we need another pair of hands! Both our domestic and maintenance clients are flat tack! We have big plans to make 2026 a great year!

Now, if you’re not looking right now yourself but you have a mate who is, we offer a $2,000 referral fee when we hire the person you refer. The only condition is that they work with us for at least 6 months…we don’t want any Muppets!

Here’s why working with us will be the best career move you ever make:
Earn $50 -$60+ per hour + Bonus for a job well done
Continuous development opportunities
You get a company vehicle and phone allowance
Plenty of technical support from the best in the business
Lots of training to ensure you become the best
Uniforms and boots provided
A paid day off for your birthday

Beers, barbeques and lots of fun social events –you’ll need a sense of humour! 

Here’s what we need from you:
Be either a qualified (even if only just out of your time) Fridgie or Electrician.
Have a current Drivers license.
Honest and trustworthy.
Experience with customer service.

Take pride in your work and go the extra mile to make sure the job is top notch.

Great people skills both with fellow workmates and customers.

If you think you’ve got what it takes then apply now via email with a copy of your CV and brief covering letter (with a photo of yourself) telling us why you are the right person for the job. 

Only people with the right to work in this country may apply for this position.

Employer questions

How many years' experience do you have as an Air Conditioning Installer?
Do you hold a current Refrigerant Handling Licence (RHL)?

result.description:
Waiter

•	Permanent Role 
•	$70k-$80k PA 
•	Cairns QLD

POSITION

We have a Full-time Waiter position available in Cairns, QLD 4870.

SKILLS

The role requires you to hold at least a relevant AQF (or equivalent) Cert II or above and 12 months of relevant work experience. If no relevant quali?cation, at least 2 years of relevant work experience is required.

RESPONSIBILITIES

The role of Waiter is to serve food and beverages, attend to guests’ dining requirements and ensure a high level of customer service is delivered to guests.

POSITION DUTIES

•	Greet customers professionally and provide menus and beverage lists. 
•	Take dine-in and takeaway orders accurately, including dietary requests. 
•	Communicate orders clearly to kitchen and beverage staff. 
•	Serve meals, snacks and beverages promptly to the café’s service standards. 
•	Manage multiple orders and attend to customers during busy service periods. 
•	Explain menu items and daily specials and recommend suitable food and beverages. 
•	Process payments using point-of-sale systems and cash registers. 
•	Clear, clean and reset tables and return used items to the appropriate cleaning area. 
•	Assist with reservations and customer seating when required. 
•	Monitor stock and replenish dining and service areas as required. 
•	Address customer concerns professionally and refer significant matters to management. 
•	Comply with food safety, hygiene, liquor-licensing and responsible service requirements. 
•	Work cooperatively with kitchen and front-of-house team members. 
•	Maintain clean and organised café dining and service areas. 
•	Perform other incidental and reasonable duties as requested by the employer.

ADDITIONAL ATTRIBUTES

•	Ability to work in a fast-paced environment
•	Teamwork and the ability to work independently
•	Strong work ethic
•	Excellent communication and customer service skills 
•	Good time management 
•	Knowledge of food and beverage service, including preparation methods, presentation and food safety

SALARY

Annual salary of $70,000 - $80,000 based on experience.

TO APPLY
Applications in Word format should be submitted via our website: 
https://precruitment.com.au/job-seekers/

result.description:
On behalf of our client, we are seeking a full-time experienced Contract Administrator.  

This role plays a key part in ensuring that client engagements, labour allocations, and transport service arrangements for our client are accurately documented, actively managed, and aligned with contractual requirements.
Working closely with operations, scheduling, and client-facing teams, you will ensure that contracts are effectively administered across their full lifecycle - from onboarding through to variations, performance tracking, and reporting. 

Key Responsibilities:
You will be responsible for:
• Preparing, reviewing and maintaining contracts relating to logistics services, including container unloading, transport and related operational services
• Managing contract variations and change requests (e.g. changes to scope, service levels, volumes or pricing), ensuring appropriate documentation and approvals are in place
• Coordinating contract setup and onboarding of new client engagements, including maintaining registers, tracking key dates, and ensuring all required documentation is complete
• Ensuring labour deployment aligns with contractual obligations, agreed service levels, and client requirements
• Monitoring contractor and service delivery performance against contractual terms, including KPIs, SLAs and agreed deliverables
• Investigating and resolving contract-related queries or discrepancies (e.g. invoicing, service scope, or delivery issues) in collaboration with operations
• Preparing reports and updates for management on contract status, variations, risks and performance outcomes
• Assisting with submissions, service proposals and renewals, including compiling supporting documentation
• Maintaining accurate records across systems to ensure contract and operational data is up to date and audit-ready

Qualifications, Skills & Experience
• A Diploma or higher qualification in a related field; or
• At least 3 years experience in contract administration (preferably within logistics, transport, labour hire or a similar operational environment).
• Demonstrated experience in contract administration, preferably within logistics, supply chain, transport, or labour hire environments
• Strong ability to interpret and manage contract terms, including variations, extensions and service adjustments
• Experience supporting operational teams with contract-linked activities such as workforce allocation, service delivery tracking or invoicing
• High attention to detail, particularly when managing large volumes of documentation and data
• Strong organisational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple contracts and priorities simultaneously
• Effective stakeholder engagement skills, including working with operations teams, clients and contractors
• Strong written communication skills, particularly in drafting formal correspondence, reports and summaries
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office and experience working with CRM, ERP or contract management systems

Salary: $90,000 - $110,000 per annum (excluding superannuation)
